title: Broaden the architecture description method in 3.2
requirements:
- Introduce the many-to-many relation between elements and systems when the two-layer model is first described
- Recommend views for audiences beyond function, realisation and motivation
- Give a practical workflow for adapting, extending or setting aside reference elements
- Clarify that considerations outside the structural views remain requirements and constraints
- Define minimum behaviours that hold whether an element is central, federated or distributed
